FN-RBS1WMN-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 523
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Kenyatté Hassell
Commissions
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/15/2025
House Bill 523 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Board of
Pardons and Paroles to establish rules to comply with the provisions of this bill regarding parole
hearings and their parole decisions.
